content.introduction: Meta announced new features for Instagram's school partnership program in the US, expanding tools for schools and students to protect teens online. Tesla secured $30 billion in credit agreements, including a $20 billion delayed draw-term loan facility. US President Donald Trump stated tech executives agreed to establish voluntary standards for AI and supported rapid expansion of data centers. Anthropic, the developer of Claude, plans one of the biggest IPOs in history as a public benefit corporation. CNBC reported on Robinhood's weekend trading hours and AI agents, Trump's unsettled AI safety meeting, and legal issues surrounding OpenAI.
body:
Meta said on Tuesday it is adding new features to Instagram's school ​partnership program in the US, expanding tools ‌for schools and students as the social media company steps up efforts to protect teens ​online.
 Tesla has entered into credit agreements totaling $30 billion, including a $20 ​billion delayed draw-term loan facility, according to ‌a regulatory filing on Tuesday. [...] US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said ​tech executives agreed to establish voluntary standards for AI and reiterated his support for rapid expansion of data centers, as concerns mount over AI safety and the ‌industry's growing footprint in communities. [...] AI lab Anthropic, the developer of Claude, is planning one of the biggest IPOs in history as a public benefit corporation, a legal structure that requires management to consider certain broader interests as well as turning a profit for investors. Below is a look at how public benefit corporations ​differ from traditional companies.
 US President Donald Trump said ​he signed an artificial intelligence-related document on Tuesday ‌with top tech executives in Washington.
